class.name: easynav_sensors/PointPerceptionHandler
class.description: Handler for point-cloud sensors. Supports sensor_msgs/msg/PointCloud2 and sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan message types. Perceptions are stored in NavState under the "points" group (or a custom group).

class.name: easynav_sensors/IMUPerceptionHandler
class.description: Handler for IMU sensors. Supports sensor_msgs/msg/Imu message type. Perceptions are stored in NavState under the "imu" group.

class.name: easynav_sensors/GNSSPerceptionHandler
class.description: Handler for GNSS/GPS sensors. Supports sensor_msgs/msg/NavSatFix message type. Perceptions are stored in NavState under the "gnss" group.

class.name: easynav_sensors/OdometryPerceptionHandler
class.description: Handler for odometry sensors. Supports nav_msgs/msg/Odometry message type. Perceptions are stored in NavState under the "odom" group.

class.name: easynav_sensors/ImagePerceptionHandler
class.description: Handler for image sensors. Supports sensor_msgs/msg/Image message type. Perceptions are stored in NavState under the "image" group.

class.name: easynav_sensors/DetectionsPerceptionHandler
class.description: Handler for 3D object detection sensors. Supports vision_msgs/msg/Detection3DArray message type. Perceptions are stored in NavState under the "detections" group.
